source_snapshot.procedure: Enable persistence, run `dcgmi diag -v -r 4`, then start service.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Resolve level scope and require path topology, link state and AER deltas.

old_problem: DeepSeek silently narrowed source level 4 to level 2, and neither generic result nor script reference tied PCIe outcomes to GPU paths, negotiated links or preserved AER counters.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA documents `pcie` in levels 2 through 4 and states higher levels include preceding suites. Therefore source level 4 preserves PCIe plus broader coverage; level 2 cannot replace it, though the PCIe plugin result remains independently attributable.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row361 all 18 XLSX columns and history2956.
Applied official suite membership showing PCIe is included in level 4.
No link, service, persistence or diagnostic state changed.

test_case.test_name: DCGM level-4 PCIe path, bandwidth, latency and error validation
test_case.purpose: Run the source-required extended suite and prove the named PCIe plugin validates every selected GPU path without link downgrade, integrity/performance failure or new AER/link error.
required_package: Pinned DCGM/driver/GPU compatibility and reviewed script/hash or exact command
PCIe plugin parameters/thresholds and AER/link-counter policy
Isolation, runtime states, monitoring and link-recovery plan
test_case.test_command: Preserve logs and capture per-path topology, speed/width and AER/link counters; establish approved DCGM state, run the pinned source-level-4 diagnostic once, retain the named PCIe plugin and every suite result, then compare post-link state/counters and restore runtime state.
test_case.expected_result: Every expected GPU path remains present at approved speed/width, the PCIe plugin and all applicable level-4 tests pass, measured PCIe/P2P checks meet the pinned DCGM configuration, and no prohibited AER/link delta occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires named PCIe results plus per-path link/counter evidence and complete level-4 accounting; level 2 alone, exit 0 or a link that retrained narrower cannot pass.
safety_gate: Drain GPU workloads and approve extended diagnostics
Preserve existing AER/log evidence; no clearing
Monitor link, thermal, power, XID and host health
Stop on disappearance, downgrade or new prohibited error; no retry
expected_evidence: Full level-4 output with PCIe metrics/results
test_case.recovery: Abort on link degradation, restore only recorded runtime state, verify enumeration and negotiated links through OOB/OS, isolate a degraded path and do not retrain or rerun automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Official suite membership makes source level 4 authoritative and rejects DeepSeek's narrower level-2 substitution.

blocked.reason: The PCIe plugin and level scope are defined; topology/threshold values are runtime inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind pinned script/config, topology/link expectations, PCIe thresholds, counter policy and recovery limits.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; INVASIVE RUN APPROVAL REQUIRED; NOT EXECUTED
pending.unlock_condition: Approve the level-4 PCIe run package.
